props.text: @media query matching
Resize this window to check live media re-evaluation. Green or blue state boxes are active media rules; yellow boxes are intentionally inactive.
min-width: 700px
Active at the default 760px window width.
Resize wider than 700px to activate.
max-width: 640px
Active after narrowing the window below 640px.
Currently inactive until the window is narrow.
orientation: landscape
Landscape rule is active.
Resize to a wider-than-tall window to activate.
orientation: portrait
Portrait rule is active.
Resize to a taller-than-wide window to activate.
pointer + hover
Desktop fine pointer and hover rule is active.
This should only stay yellow on non-hover/coarse input.
comma query list
Active from min-height: 580px at the default size.
Inactive only if both width > 480px and height < 580px.
prefers-color-scheme
Dark color scheme rule is active.
Light color scheme rule is active.
Exactly one of the two scheme labels should be visible.
prefers-reduced-motion
no-preference rule is active.
This should stay yellow if the platform reports reduced motion.

dirty.note: DragonGUI applies coarse dirty flags immediately; this history records the recent command reasons that triggered them.
